verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say you can issue cards and attach controls, "physical for employee in-person spend, virtual for reusable payment details." The homepage describes "instant virtual cards" with per-vendor spending limits. Funds add per-card budgets with amount, interval and merchant/category restrictions, and virtual cards can also be issued programmatically via the API. Missing for 10: no evidence on how quickly physical cards are issued or delivered (the "in minutes" claim is only backed for virtual cards), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
